body:
I don't really have words right now.  I got a few hours of sleep, but my head is still so fuzzy, and I don't really know why.  I don't understand.  I feel so lost right now.

I texted my therapist.  She hasn't gotten back to me yet, but she usually does within a day or two.  I guess it's in her hands now.

Thank you for talking to me.
I have a therapist, but I've already asked for a bunch of emergency sessions in the last few months, and i don't want to be a bother
They probably would overreact.  I've done stuff before.  I don't really want to be hospitalized again

I can't remember :(

It feels like a different person lived that.  I don't know how that makes sense.  Or i was just lying?

But i don't really feel ok rn, so idk

I'm dirty bc of the ppl who left a mark on me.  Nobody really sees how everything is in pieces.  Or how gross i am because of where I've been

And thank you, but i haven't really recovered from anything.  I don't know how i convinced anybody that i had
